name: Primary Interstitial Lung Disease Specific to Childhood Due to Alveolar Vascular Disorder
aliases: Childhood Interstitial Lung Disease with Alveolar Vascular Abnormalities
Pediatric Alveolar Vascular Interstitial Lung Disease

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Pediatric Interstitial Lung Disease Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Progressive respiratory symptoms including tachypnea and hypoxemia in early childhood
High-resolution CT showing diffuse interstitial lung abnormalities with alveolar septal thickening and vascular remodeling
Lung biopsy demonstrating alveolar capillary dysplasia or vascular malformations with interstitial fibrosis
Exclusion of infectious, immunological, and other known causes of interstitial lung disease
Identification of mutations in genes related to alveolar vascular development (e.g., FOXF1)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive respiratory symptoms, characteristic imaging findings, and confirmatory histopathology with exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing can support diagnosis but is not mandatory; lung biopsy remains gold standard.

searchTerms: low oxygen levels not improving with oxygen therapy
oxygen therapy failing to raise blood oxygen

laboratory: Hypoxemia on arterial blood gas analysis
Elevated brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) in cases with pulmonary hypertension
imaging: High-resolution CT showing diffuse interstitial infiltrates, alveolar septal thickening, and vascular abnormalities
Echocardiography demonstrating pulmonary hypertension and right heart strain
genetic: Mutations in FOXF1 gene associated with alveolar capillary dysplasia
Other rare mutations affecting alveolar vascular development pathways
other: Lung biopsy revealing alveolar capillary dysplasia with misalignment of pulmonary veins and interstitial fibrosis

distinguishingFeatures: Characteristic misalignment of pulmonary veins on histology
Progressive fibrosis without prominent vascular abnormalities
Later onset compared to alveolar vascular disorders

redFlags: Rapidly progressive hypoxemia unresponsive to supplemental oxygen
Failure to thrive despite adequate nutrition
Development of pulmonary hypertension in early childhood
references: Nathan N, et al. Pediatric Interstitial Lung Disease: Diagnosis and Management. Pediatr Pulmonol. 2022.
Galambos C, et al. Alveolar Capillary Dysplasia and Related Disorders. Orphanet J Rare Dis. 2021.
Orphanet Report on Primary Interstitial Lung Disease Specific to Childhood Due to Alveolar Vascular Disorder. 2023.
